parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description:
The accelerated domain name to query.
- Separate multiple domain names with commas (,). You can specify up to 100 domain names at a time.
- When you query multiple domain names, the returned data is the aggregated data of all specified domain names.
- Log on to the [ApsaraVideo VOD console](https://vod.console.aliyun.com), and choose **Configuration Management > CDN Configuration > Domain Names** in the left-side navigation pane to view the accelerated domain names that you have added to ApsaraVideo VOD. You can also call the [DescribeVodUserDomains](~~455030~~) operation to query the list of accelerated domain names.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.
> The end time must be later than the start time.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.
